Scoring multiple <stasis/>Stasis Weapon Kills spawns a Small Stasis Shard.

Activation progress on Kills by <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Minors: 34?%
• Elites and Enemy Players: 67%

Further Kills do not provide activation progress for 5? seconds after activation.
